general.name: Order Cleanup
general.title: Order Cleanup
general.description: Clear all orders, documents and reset number generators

card.title: Danger Zone
card.warning: This action is irreversible and will permanently delete data.
card.description: Clicking the button below will permanently delete:

item.orders: All orders and related data (line items, transactions, deliveries, addresses)
item.documents: All order documents (invoices, credit notes, etc.)
item.media: All document media files (PDFs) from the media library
item.numberRanges: Number range counters (order numbers will restart from the configured start value)

modal.title: Are you sure?
modal.body: This will permanently delete ALL orders, documents and media files, and reset all order number counters. This action cannot be undone.

notifications.successMessage: All orders, documents and number range counters have been cleared.
notifications.errorMessage: An error occurred during cleanup. Please check the logs.
